title: SA module-protocol v4 golden vector
description: Skeleton schema for golden vectors consumed by both kernels (ordinary #39, native #40). 'TODO(kernel39|40)' values are placeholders filled by the kernel batches.

constantsRevision.description: Git blob sha (or commit) of contracts/custom/SmartAccount.ModuleProtocol.cs the vector was generated against.

input.description: Exact byte-level inputs: network, coreHash (hex), accountId (hex), keys, subkeys, operation fields.
